name: io.github.GuiBibeau/solos
title: solOS
description: Solana execution layer for LLM agents: swaps, lending, perps, liquidity, transfers, market reads.

environmentVariables.name: SOLOS_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Wallet profile saved by `solos login`; the default profile when unset

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC URL; overrides the profile's. Mainnet by default, the URL is the only network switch

environmentVariables.name: SOLOS_TOOL_TIER
environmentVariables.description: Highest tier the server offers: read, simulate or execute

environmentVariables.name: SOLOS_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to `all` to advertise every tool up front instead of on demand

environmentVariables.name: JUPITER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Unlocks swap quotes and price reads

environmentVariables.name: SOLOS_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Level of the JSON logs on stderr
